start:
Short Video Knowledge Base Bot

Paste a Douyin link, I will analyze and create a knowledge card.

Commands:
/stats - Knowledge base stats
/search <keyword> - Search
/help - Help
help:
Usage:

1. Paste a Douyin video link
   Supported: douyin.com/... or v.douyin.com/...

2. Bot processes automatically (~10-30 sec)

Commands:
/stats - View stats
/search <keyword> - Search
search_hint:
Please provide a keyword
Usage: /search AI tutorial
timeout: Processing timeout (90s), API server may be waking up. Try again later.
note_discuss_hint: 直接輸入問題即可繼續討論（5 分鐘內有效）
note_help:
Notes:
  Just type any text (not a URL or /command) to save a note.
  AI will auto-categorize and analyze.

Commands:
  /notes - List recent notes
  /notes <category> - Filter by category
  /search <keyword> - Search notes
  /delete <id> - Delete a note
  /note_help - This help
